assumptions: The exercise is performed standing between two low cable pulleys, as shown in the demonstration.
Each repetition consists of pressing one cable handle overhead while the opposite handle remains held at shoulder height; sides alternate.
The overhead pressing path is represented as glenohumeral abduction in the shoulder/scapular plane, consistent with the shoulder-height, palms-forward setup and depicted overhead finish.
The exercise is repetition-based rather than duration-based.
classification_reasons: The instructions and contact sheet consistently show a standing, alternating unilateral cable overhead press from a shoulder-height start.
The admitted vocabulary can represent the primary concentric elbow extension and shoulder elevation, along with the required unilateral standing stabilization demands.
